verdict.rationale: DBOS Conductor's API and the dbosctl CLI document managing API keys alongside members and roles, so the product can issue credentials an agent could use. The evidence never shows those keys being scoped to specific permissions or tied to least-privilege roles. missing for 10: documented per-key permission scoping or role binding, agent-specific credential guidance, key expiry/rotation details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: manage members, roles, and API keys
It manages workflows, queues, schedules, applications, and API keys against DBOS-managed Conductor or a self-hosted Conductor
